summary: Classic RC4 stream cipher: initializes a 256-byte S-box to the identity, runs the key-scheduling algorithm over key a1 of length a2, then generates keystream and XORs it into buffer a3 for a4 bytes, returning a4. The swap primitive is ByteSwap at 0x005622B0.

operations.description: Initialize the 256-byte S-box v17 with identity values 0..255.
Key scheduling algorithm: j = (j + key[i % keylen] + sbox[i]) mod 256, then swap sbox[i] and sbox[j]; iterates over all 256 entries using the key a1 of length a2.
Invoke ByteSwap to swap two S-box entries during key scheduling and keystream generation.
Only run the stream-cipher output stage when data length a4 is positive.
Keystream generation and application: advance i, j = (j + sbox[i]) mod 256, swap sbox[i] and sbox[j], XOR data[a3 + n] with sbox[(sbox[i] + sbox[j]) mod 256] for each of a4 bytes.
Return the data length a4 as the result.
